clues: This big city sits on the Pirai River. It lies in the low lands in the east of Bolivia.
This city's land sits low in the Amazon basin. So its weather is tropical, not like the high main city far above it.
A man from Spain, Ñuflo de Chavez, founded this city in 1561. It first stood far to the east, then moved again and again.
This one city makes nearly 35% of all that Bolivia makes. It gets over 40% of the cash firms bring from abroad.
This city has the most people in Bolivia. It is the largest city in the whole land.
